'''Vexan''' was a [[Constable/Legends|constable]] on [[Andasala/Legends|Andasala]] who was in the employ of the [[loan shark]] [[Sires Vant]]. He stopped [[Reshig]], who owed Vant money, from leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
